label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Rohan da, fair question. Divya’s question is even fairer. And Sneha, I’m breathing, mostly on Maggi fumes. Ajay has already done the LinkedIn comedy, so let me try the truth.

Straight answer: last Friday I let go 6 of 14 people. Everyone got two months’ pay, and 4 already have interviews lined up. It was the worst day of my life. Worse than failing maths in 2nd sem, and that was a proper low bar. I’m not going to call it “rightsizing” or “leaner and meaner”. It was a shit day, and I’m still sitting with it.

The money part. The Hyderabad fund bridge fell through on 28 Oct. Term sheet was basically ready. The partner said “we love the energy” on the call and then stopped replying for 11 days. I’ve been ghosted before, but never with such warm energy. After the cuts we have about 5 months runway. App is around 41k monthly users. The plumbers and electricians side is actually growing. AC servicing is bleeding money, so we’re shutting that side and focusing on housing society tie-ups. We’ve already signed pilots with 3 societies in HSR. I think we have a real shot there. Not a sure thing. I’m not going to stand here and pretend it is.

Your 3 lakh is in the friends round from 2025, same terms as everyone else. I can’t tell you and Divya that it’s safe. I genuinely don’t know. Money is at risk, not gone. That’s the straight answer, and you have every right to ask it. You trusted me with real money. Divya is asking over dinner, not in a board meeting, and that’s fair.

Keep the sad face in draft for now. Don’t start practising yet. Can we do a proper call this week, you and Divya? I’ll show you the numbers, runway, society pipeline, everything. No slides, no founder jargon. If after that you want to call me an idiot, you’re allowed. Maybe not in front of Pranav.

I’m fine, by the way. Mostly. Maggi at 11pm so often that the security uncle now asks “masala or plain?” Amma asked last week if TCS is still hiring. So yeah, due diligence from all sides.

I’m coming Saturday. Pranav is buying. That is the only guaranteed thing in this message.
